name: VIP Lounge
description: An exclusive area for high-rollers and digital aristocracy, separated from the common floor by a velvet rope and crushing social hierarchy. Plush seating made from memory foam that actually remembers. A champagne fountain flows with liquid gold (it's just food coloring). Floor-to-ceiling windows show a cityscape that doesn't exist in this dimension. Everything is expensive, exclusive, and slightly disappointing—the true VIP experience. A sign reads: 'If you have to ask if you belong here, you don't.'
